notes.title: Small content patch!
notes.content: [p]Hey guys!  It seems Steam may be aiming to cut a particular kind of content from NSFW titles, and - just to be safe - I'm removing one scene that may have potentially violated some new rules that may (or may not) be placed into effect.   [/p][p][/p][p]Just wanted to keep everyone updated, and be as transparent as I can. If at any time later it is determined that Steam does not intend to ban all games containing nonconsensual content, then I will bring it back. But until such a time, I'd rather be safe than sorry.   The only scene to be cut was a fairly obscure bad end, anyway.   More details will be available on the [url="https://discord.gg/fTqXazge75"]Discord[/url], if anyone has any questions![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Due to new security changes at Steam, I am not currently able to publish this update, and will not be able to for 72 hours. But it will be posted as soon as I'm able.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][u]In future update news:[/u]  [/p][p][/p][p]The next update is well underway, and approaching ~70% completion, so it won't be too long now! :)[/p]

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Here with a status update! 

So, while trying not to be too long winded, or spoilery, here's where we're at:

[list]
[*]This update structure contains a linear scene, as well as the first part of a massive free-roam. The linear scene is completely written and rendered, starting on animation work today ... 

[*]The *framework* for the freeroam segment has all been built (from scratch), mapped and rendered in full. I tested it yesterday, everything's flowing like a champ!

[*]There [b]are[/b] close to 20 events that branch off of it, though. I've got ~80% of those side events written, with 2 completely rendered, as well as a bit of the third. So, all in all, i'd say this update is about ~15% complete.
[/list]

If I get this first path of the freeroam done in an acceptable amount of time, then i will include the second branch as part of this update as well. But we'll see where things land :) I want to try to keep everything within a 3 months release cycle, as best i can. (This isn't a guarantee, just a rough timeline for me to keep track)

Anyway, thought you guys might like to know! :)

And, if anyone remembers "Kiara" - the woman from that training yard, that stepped up to fight colt in training - She gets a face reveal. Due to how well she was received, and liked, I've decided to transition her from a one-off side character, to a recurring one. You will see *much* more of Kiara in the coming updates ;)
